summary: Reconnect WAL converges redis-AOF style: unsynced event appends, fsync only on reserved/terminal/ack, poison on failed append, online compaction with a 2x floor, ledger counts only unresolved ids; export/delete/GC refuse a live owner or unresolved WAL evidence and otherwise remove the WAL with the session.

notes: Design adjusted vs original row: events buffered (appended without fsync) instead of removed; WAL kept after clean close for cross-process idempotency; a closed WAL blocks removal only while it holds unresolved evidence.
